newsitem.title: USA: UAL expanding flight training facility.
newsitem.headline: UAL expanding flight training facility.

text.p: United Airlines, a unit of UAL Corp, said Thursday it broke ground to expand its pilot training facility, the Denver Flight Center.
The $100 million expansion, scheduled for completion in May 1997, is expected to bring at least 100 new permanent jobs to the Denver area.
The groundbreaking follows an agreement reached by United, the City of Denver and the Stapleton Development Corp that supports redevelopment of the Stapleton Airport property.

United said the expansion includes a new 100,000-square-foot building that will house 10 full-flight simulator bays, space for fixed-based simulators, ground training classrooms and office space for simulator maintenance and for UAL Services, a United Airlines subsidiary.
